title: load_messages_for_chat hard limit 500 with no pagination
description: event.rs load_messages_for_chat sends Message/query with limit: 500 and position: 0 (line 351). If a chat has more than 500 messages the 500 most recent are fetched (assuming the server returns newest-first, which is not guaranteed by the JMAP query). If the server returns oldest-first (position 0 = oldest), the user sees the oldest 500 messages not the newest 500. The truncation notice is shown but it says 'N older messages not shown' — if server returns oldest-first, the visible messages ARE the oldest so the notice is misleading. The query sort order should be specified explicitly.
